author: Marlon Chaviano
name: monorepo-spring-react
title: Spring Boot + React in one repo
description: A Spring Boot backend (Maven, Java 17) and a React + Vite frontend in the same repo: the classic shape of an enterprise product, ready to build.

base.command: mkdir {{name}} && cd {{name}} && curl -fsSL https://start.spring.io/starter.tgz -d type=maven-project -d language=java -d javaVersion=17 -d dependencies=web,validation,actuator -d groupId=com.example -d artifactId=backend -d name=backend -d baseDir=backend | tar -xzf - && npx -y create-vite@latest frontend --template react-ts --no-interactive

verify.command: cd backend && ./mvnw -q -B test && cd ../frontend && npm run build

instructions:
## How to work here

- `backend/` is Spring Boot (start with `cd backend && ./mvnw spring-boot:run`) and `frontend/` is React + Vite (`cd frontend && npm run dev`).
- REST controllers under `/api`, with validated DTOs (`@Valid`) and the logic in services.
- Before finishing: `./mvnw test` in `backend/` and `npm run build` in `frontend/`.
- Each app lives in its own folder with its own dependencies; don't mix code from one into another.
- Whatever backend and frontend share (types, API contracts) is defined in one place and documented.
